 Development ⚙ 
 If you haven't already, install Docker and DDEV 

 
git clone git@git.drupal.org:project/knowledge.git
cd knowledge
ddev config --project-type=drupal --docroot=web --php-version=8.3 --corepack-enable --project-name=knowledge
ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-drupal-contrib
ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-selenium-standalone-chrome
ddev start
ddev poser
ddev symlink-project
ddev drush site:install -y
ddev drush pm:install knowledge -y
ddev drush config:export -y
ddev drush user:login
